title: Chapter 2734 - 98: Hard
content:
Chapter 2734: Chapter 98: Hard-Earned Easy Living

The inner turmoil within "Wu Cha" was immense.

At that moment, he truly realized the vastness of the world, with powerful individuals as numerous as the fish crossing the river, and himself as insignificant as a drop in the ocean.

In the eyes of true power, he might indeed be as insignificant as an "ant."

Before him stood five Great cultivators in the Golden Core Realm, along with Foundation Establishment Realm experts gathered like a forest; Wu Cha’s legs began to tremble, nearly unable to stand.

Dan Zhu asked Wu Cha: "Who are you?"

Wu Cha wanted to speak, but his throat was dry and he couldn’t utter a word, only trembling as he presented the letter in his hand.

Elder Ba Shan took the letter and handed it to Dan Zhu.

Upon seeing the letter, Dan Zhu’s eyes brightened slightly, nodded, and then said to Wu Cha: "Lead the way."

Wu Cha hurriedly bowed his head and said:

"Yes."

Wu Cha then led the way, and the group moved magnificently through the Wu Cha Mountain Realm to the Wutu Mountain Realm, and finally to the Wutu Tribe.

A force of Golden Core-level Barbarian Soldiers, entering a Second Grade Mountain Realm, was like a powerful dragon traversing the land, with an extremely shocking presence of power.

Chieftains and elders of various tribes, feeling this overwhelming aura, all turned pale, their hearts filled with fear.

Wu Cha led the way at the front.

As the new "Chieftain" and "Commander" of the Mountain Realm, he seemed like a mere "pawn."

Throughout the journey, his heart was filled with immense anxiety.

The initial shock had turned into deep worry and fear.

He did not understand why these legendary figures, these high and mighty Golden Cores, had suddenly descended upon the Small Mountain Realm.

Yet with the arrival of the Golden Cores, how could these Second Grade tribes survive?

This overwhelming force, capable of flattening these small tribes’ Barbarian Soldiers with hardly any effort at all.

The Shaman had said these people were his "guests".

But would these Golden Cores, this formidable force, truly have the self-awareness of "guests"?

If they did not wish to be "guests" but instead wanted to be "hosts", what could the Shaman possibly do?

What could the Shaman do against these Golden Core strong people?

Wasn’t this like... "inviting wolves into the house"?

Wu Cha pursed his lips tightly, his expression growing more solemn, the tension in his heart reaching its peak as these Golden Cores and elite Barbarian Soldiers arrived at the Wutu Tribe.

He truly feared that, should conflict arise, these small mountain realms would be annihilated in an instant without any chance to resist.

However, everything he feared never came to pass.

These Golden Core cultivators and their powerful Barbarian Soldiers caused no harm along the way.

And when they entered the Wutu Tribe and met the Shaman, the five Golden Core strong people, including the five to six hundred powerful Barbarian Soldiers, all saluted, respectfully addressing:

"Gentleman."

"Mr. Witch."

"Shaman..."

Mo Hua appeared as calm as ever and gently said: "Thank you for your hard work."

Wu Cha was stunned, and slowly felt a massive stone in his heart slowly settle.

But moments later, his pupils began to tremble, and an unbelievable suspicion arose in his mind.

Could it be that these people were not the Shaman’s... guests?

But rather, the Shaman’s... comrades, or even subordinates?

This was not merely a powerful dragon crossing the land, but actually, a "dragon" nurtured by the Shaman himself?!

The Shaman did not explicitly say so, but the more Wu Cha observed, the more it seemed so.

The shock in his heart was like a tempestuous wave, resonating within.

And when he looked at Mo Hua again, he suddenly felt that the figure of the Shaman seemed as high as the "heavens," towering to the point of instilling fear.

And this sense of "unreachable" fear was not felt by Wu Cha alone.

Jiao Li, and even the minor chieftains and some insightful elders of various tribes, are now largely speechless with shock in their hearts.

The Shaman’s apparent cultivation was merely at Foundation Establishment.

Yet five Golden Core strong people revered him greatly.

Five to six hundred strong Foundation Establishment soldiers obeyed his every command.

What kind of majesty was this? What kind of charisma, what kind of... unbelievable power was this?

At this moment, Mo Hua’s figure, in their hearts, was almost akin to a "deity" in the sky.

...

After some time of turmoil, the original tribes of the Wutu Mountain Realm gradually accepted this fact, and the various astonishments gradually settled down.

The power of Dan Zhu’s group was temporarily settled in the Wutu Small Mountain Realm, resting securely.

And with Mo Hua, a Shaman whose prestige was as revered as a "deity," overseeing the Small Mountain Realm, everything soon became routine again.

The Black Horn Tribe’s Jiao Li dared not have any other thoughts.

The commander of the Wu Cha Mountain Realm, "Wu Cha," was replaced, and the tribe began to reform.

All tribal disputes and personal grievances gradually dissipated under Mo Hua’s majesty.

In the Wutu Tribe, the sound of children reading aloud began to resound once more.

The principles Mo Hua advocated began to spread again in the Wutu Mountain Realm.

...

As the situation stabilized somewhat, Mo Hua felt at ease, gave a few instructions to Elder Zamu, and planned to venture into the Wutu Deep Mountains to see the Big Tiger.

He had not seen the Big Tiger for over a year, and he did not know how the Big Tiger was doing, whether it was starving, or facing any unexpected dangers.

Mo Hua was still a bit worried.

However, before he set out, Elder Zamu’s expression appeared somewhat serious: "Shaman, are you... heading into the deep mountains?"

Mo Hua nodded and asked, "What’s the matter?"

Elder Zamu hesitantly said: "The deep mountains have been... somewhat dangerous lately."

"Dangerous?" Mo Hua was slightly taken aback.

Elder Zamu said: "Our Wutu Clan, following your orders, treated the Wutu Mountain’s deep mountains as a forbidden area, and usually never ventured there. The deep mountains have always been peaceful."

"But in the past six months, for some reason, the Monster Qi in the deep mountains has suddenly intensified a lot, and also..."
